info.title: Text-to-SQL & Document Chat Platform
info.description: Multi-tenant platform for natural language database queries and document chat

post.description:
Authenticate user and return JWT token pair.

The username is looked up across all tenants (login doesn't require
knowing the tenant beforehand). The tenant_id is embedded in the
token from the user's record.
Refresh token rotation: validate refresh token, issue a new pair.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's information, scoped by their JWT tenant.

post.description: Create a new database connection. Password is encrypted at rest.

get.description: List all database connections for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api Database Connections Get

get.description: Get a specific database connection by ID.

put.description: Update a database connection. Re-encrypts password if changed.

post.description: Test a database connection. Decrypts credentials transiently in memory.
Introspect database schema via connection adapter and cache metadata.

get.description: Get discovered schema metadata for a connection.

schema.title: Response Get Schemas Api Database Connections  Connection Id  Schemas Get

get.description: Get discovered tables (nested under schemas) for a connection.

schema.title: Response Get Tables Api Database Connections  Connection Id  Tables Get

post.description: Grant or configure table permissions for a role.

get.description: List configured table permissions for a connection.

schema.title: Response List Connection Permissions Api Permissions Connections  Connection Id  Get

delete.description: Delete a table permission by ID.

post.description: Process a natural language question against a database connection.

schema.title: Response Execute Text To Sql Api Query Sql Post

get.description: List all knowledge bases for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response List Knowledge Bases Api Knowledge Bases Get

get.description: Get a knowledge base by ID.

post.description:
Upload and process a document file.

Supported types: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, TXT.
Processing: parse → chunk → embed → store (synchronous).

get.description: List files in a knowledge base.

schema.title: Response List Files Api Files Get

delete.description: Delete a file and its chunks.

post.description: Re-process an existing file (e.g. after model upgrade).

Synchronous chat endpoint.

Returns response matching assignment Section 9 contract shape exactly:
message_id, conversation_id, intent, answer, sources_used, sql, citations.
SSE streaming chat endpoint emitting typed events (intent, sql_result, citation, token, done).

get.description: List all conversations for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api Conversations Get

get.description: Get conversation details with full message history.

delete.description: Delete a conversation and its messages.

get.description: Get standalone list of citations for a specific message.

schema.title: Response Get Message Citations Api Messages  Message Id  Citations Get

get.description: Get standalone SQL execution details for a specific message.
List audit log entries for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response Get Audit Logs Api Audit Logs Get
